```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
alldata <- read.csv("STAT137_Gun_Sales_2000_2015.csv")
```

## Question 1

```{r, include=FALSE}
head(alldata)
dim(alldata)
str(alldata)

sum(is.na(alldata)) 

table(alldata$state)

national <- subset(alldata, state == "Totals")
national <- national[order(national$year,
national$month.num), ]
national$sales <- 1.1 * (national$handgun + national$longgun) +
2 * national$multiple_corrected

Y <- ts(national$sales, start = c(2000, 1), frequency = 12)
```

## Question 2

```{r}
plot(Y, type = "l", col = "steelblue", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Estimated sales (firearms per month)",
     main = "Estimated U.S. monthly firearm sales, 2000-2015")
abline(v = 2015, lty = 2, col = "red") 
text(2015, max(Y), "Test (2015)", pos = 2, col = "red", cex = 0.8)

top <- order(national$sales, decreasing = TRUE)[1:4]
points(time(Y)[top], Y[top], col = "red", pch = 19)
```

## Question 3

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Training-only regression data (for questions below)
d <- data.frame(y = as.numeric(Y), t = 1:192,
month = factor(rep(1:12, 16)))
train <- d[1:180, ]
test <- d[181:192, ]

# Table of average sales by calendar month
month_tab <- aggregate(y ~ month, data = train,
                       FUN = function(x) c(mean = mean(x), median = median(x)))
print(month_tab)
```

```{r}
# Boxplot by month
boxplot(y ~ month, data = train, names = month.abb,
        xlab = "Calendar month", ylab = "Estimated sales (firearms per month)",
        main = "Estimated sales by calendar month, 2000-2014", col = "lightblue")
```

## Question 4

```{r, include=FALSE}
fit <- lm(y ~ t + month, data = train)
summary(fit)
```

```{r}
train$res <- resid(fit)
plot(1:180, train$res, type = "l", col = "steelblue",
     xlab = "Month index t (1 = Jan 2000, 180 = Dec 2014)",
     ylab = "Residual (firearms per month)",
     main = "Residuals from trend + month regression")
abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
```

## Question 5

```{r}
res <- train$res

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
acf(res,  lag.max = 36, main = "Sample ACF of residuals",
    xlab = "Lag (months)", ylab = "Autocorrelation")
pacf(res, lag.max = 36, main = "Sample PACF of residuals",
     xlab = "Lag (months)", ylab = "Partial autocorrelation")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## Question 6

```{r, include=FALSE}
m_ar   <- arima(res, order = c(2, 0, 0))   # AR(2)
m_ma   <- arima(res, order = c(0, 0, 4))   # MA(4)
m_arma <- arima(res, order = c(1, 0, 1))   # ARMA(1,1)

m_ar; m_ma; m_arma  # coefficients, sigma^2, aic
c(AR2 = AIC(m_ar), MA4 = AIC(m_ma), ARMA11 = AIC(m_arma))
```

## Question 7

```{r, include=FALSE}
p_q <- c(AR2 = 2, MA4 = 4, ARMA11 = 2)
mods <- list(AR2 = m_ar, MA4 = m_ma, ARMA11 = m_arma)
```

```{r}
for (nm in names(mods)) {
  r <- resid(mods[[nm]])
  acf(r, lag.max = 36, main = paste("Residual ACF:", nm),
      xlab = "Lag (months)", ylab = "Autocorrelation")
  print(nm)
  print(Box.test(r, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box", fitdf = p_q[nm]))
}
```

## Question 8

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Deterministic part + ARMA part
det_fc  <- predict(fit, newdata = test)       # trend + season
arma_fc <- predict(m_arma, n.ahead = 12)$pred # residual forecast
fc      <- as.numeric(det_fc) + as.numeric(arma_fc)

# Benchmark: same month of 2014
naive   <- d$y[169:180]
actual  <- test$y

mae  <- function(a, p) mean(abs(a - p))
rmse <- function(a, p) sqrt(mean((a - p)^2))
data.frame(method = c("Regression + ARMA(1,1)", "Same month 2014"),
           MAE  = c(mae(actual, fc),  mae(actual, naive)),
           RMSE = c(rmse(actual, fc), rmse(actual, naive)))
```

```{r}
plot(1:12, actual, type = "b", pch = 16, ylim = range(actual, fc, naive),
     xaxt = "n", xlab = "Month of 2015",
     ylab = "Estimated sales (firearms per month)",
     main = "2015: actual vs forecasts")
axis(1, at = 1:12, labels = month.abb)
lines(1:12, fc,    type = "b", pch = 17, col = "red")
lines(1:12, naive, type = "b", pch = 15, col = "blue", lty = 2)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Regression + ARMA(1,1)", "Same month 2014"),
       col = c("black", "red", "blue"), pch = c(16, 17, 15), lty = c(1, 1, 2))
```

## Question 9

```{r, include=FALSE}
md <- subset(alldata, state == "Maryland")
md <- md[order(md$year, md$month.num), ]
md$sales <- 1.1 * (md$handgun + md$longgun) + 2 * md$multiple_corrected
MD <- ts(md$sales, start = c(2000, 1), frequency = 12)
```

```{r}
mdw <- window(MD, start = c(2012, 1), end = c(2014, 12))
plot(mdw, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "darkgreen",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Maryland estimated sales (firearms per month)",
     main = "Maryland estimated sales, 2012-2014")
abline(v = 2013 + 4/12, lty = 2, col = "red")
```
